notes: This is an unrun template, not evidence of a pass. Set status to recorded only after a physical-device run.
Scopes: steady_state, recovery, combined. A pass applies only to the recorded configuration and selected scope.
Targets are project targets: 1800 continuous steady-state seconds, zero observed error counters, 10 allowed-resumption trials within 2 seconds, plus one user-paused and one resume-disallowed trial.
observed=true means the named counter was measured throughout the steady-state interval; null/unknown or uninstrumented host counters remain incomplete.
Do not subtract interruptions or natural silence from unexplained dropout counts. Record planned interruptions explicitly as separate recovery trials.

Each recovery trial needs event, expected_interruption, user_paused, resume_allowed and audio_resumed_at_s. Allowed-resumption trials also need route_usable_at_s, resume_allowed_at_s and observation_finished_at_s. Negative trials need observation_duration_seconds and stayed_paused.
Use monotonic seconds on the same clock within a trial. Allowed-resumption latency starts at max(route_usable_at_s, resume_allowed_at_s).
audio_resumed_at_s=null explicitly records that no resumption was observed; omit no required field. Missing observations remain incomplete.

For negative trials observe at least 2 seconds, set stayed_paused=true only if playback stayed paused, and audio_resumed_at_s=null. Include separate trials for user_paused=true with resume_allowed=true, and user_paused=false with resume_allowed=false. Allowed-resumption timestamps may be null in these negative trials.
Firmware is optional. No bit-identity claim is made for Bluetooth output. The assessor evaluates supplied evidence; it does not run or instrument hardware.
